preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789' for c in input_str)
preconditions.description: The input string consists only of lowercase letters (a-z) and digits (0-9).

preconditions.expression: all(len(num) <= 2 and num.isdigit() for num in re.findall(r'\d+', input_str))
preconditions.description: Any numeric substring in the input is a 1- or 2-digit number (0-99).

preconditions.expression: not re.search(r'\d{2,}', input_str) or re.search(r'[a-z]\d{2}[a-z]', input_str)
preconditions.description: If a 2-digit number appears, it must be adjacent to at least one letter on both sides (e.g., 'a26b' is valid, but 'a262b' is not).

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789' for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: The output string consists only of lowercase letters (a-z) and digits (0-9).

postconditions.expression: all((c.isalpha() and return_value[i] == alphabetnums[c]) or (c.isdigit() and return_value[i] == alphabet[int(c)-1]) for i, c in enumerate(input_str) if c.isalpha() and int(c) <= 26) or (c.isdigit() and int(c) <= 26 and return_value[i] == alphabet[int(c)-1])
postconditions.description: For each character in the input string: if it is a letter, it is replaced by its numeric equivalent (e.g., 'a' → '1'); if it is a digit, it is replaced by the corresponding letter (e.g., '1' → 'a').

postconditions.expression: all(len(num) == 1 or (len(num) == 2 and int(num) <= 26) for num in re.findall(r'\d+', input_str)) and all(len(num) == 1 or (len(num) == 2 and int(num) <= 26) for num in re.findall(r'\d+', return_value))
postconditions.description: If a numeric substring in the input is 2 digits, it must represent a valid letter (1-26) and is replaced by the corresponding letter in the output. Single-digit numbers are replaced by their corresponding letters (e.g., '1' → 'a').
